decision: Retain stage-owned resources only in prod. Keep shared production DNS and mail infrastructure in every stage.
helper: Per-cartridge retainInProd decorators; the desk rejected a shared package dependency because cartridges must remain independently removable. Alchemy's runtime phase selects identity so deployment policy does not enter Worker startup.
authority: Alchemy state owns the persisted removal policy. Source declarations are the writer; the next successful deploy updates even noop resource rows. No cloud operation ran for this change.

lifecycle.preview: scripts/deploy-preview.sh uses pr-N and alchemy.preview.ts. Its allowlist permits only Website and RpcBackend Workers. None of the retention-decorated resources are reachable from this preview Stack today.
lifecycle.main: alchemy.run.ts has no stage-name fence. Any explicit main-Stack stage or ALCHEMY_STAGE can create the cartridge resources; Alchemy's default deploy stage is live_USER. Non-dev main-Stack stages also declare the fixed production DNS and email resources. ALCHEMY_DEV skips that shared infrastructure.
lifecycle.missingNote: The desk confirmed ship-preview-lifecycle.svx never landed; the preview script, preview Stack and preview allowlist are authoritative.
lifecycle.inventory: desk-owned; the worker has no ratstack profile. No orphan absence or presence is claimed here. Delete nothing.
